definitions.gloss: replacement item; exchange product; substitute goods
definitions.explanation: An item provided as a replacement for a defective, broken, or unsuitable product. Commonly used in retail, customer service, and warranty contexts.

examples.japanese: {交換品|こうかんひん}は{明日|あした}{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: The replacement item will arrive tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {不良品|ふりょうひん}だったので{交換品|こうかんひん}を{送|おく}ってもらった。
examples.english: It was defective, so I had them send me a replacement.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}がないため、{交換品|こうかんひん}の{発送|はっそう}まで{一週間|いっしゅうかん}ほどかかる{場合|ばあい}がございます。
examples.english: Due to lack of stock, it may take about one week to ship the replacement item.

notes:
Composed of {交換|こうかん} (exchange, replacement) and {品|ひん} (item, goods). This is the standard term used by retailers and manufacturers when providing a substitute product for one that was defective, damaged, or otherwise unsatisfactory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交換品|こうかんひん}を{送|おく}る: to send a replacement item
- {交換品|こうかんひん}が{届|とど}く: for a replacement to arrive
- {交換品|こうかんひん}の{手配|てはい}: arranging a replacement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代替品|だいたいひん}: substitute goods — a broader term for any substitute, not necessarily replacing a defective item
- {返品|へんぴん}: returned goods — the act of returning an item, often the step before receiving a {交換品|こうかんひん}
- {予備品|よびひん}: spare parts — items kept on hand as spares, rather than replacements sent after a problem
